title: The Scullery Mirror Note
description:
A charred scrap of paper was retrieved from the kitchen fireplace.
The message was written entirely in reverse order.
question:
Read the hidden phrase:

RETSAM EHT SILLIK RELTUB EHT
acceptable_answer_format:
Type the decoded sentence exactly.

Example:
THE KEY IS SAFE
hints: The words are written completely backward.
Start reading from the very last letter of the last word.
Reverse each word: RETSAM -> MASTER, EHT -> THE, SILLIK -> KILLS, RELTUB -> BUTLER, EHT -> THE.
solution_explanation: Reading the words backwards from right to left reveals: 'THE BUTLER KILLS THE MASTER'.
